# Orlo

> A design framework for React. Nothing is an afterthought.

Orlo ships tokens (@orlo/tokens), a spring motion system (@orlo/motion) and components (@orlo/react). All components are beta.

- [Installation](start/installation/): Add Orlo to a React app.

## Components
- [Button](components/button/): Solid, subtle, ghost and danger buttons with a geometry-preserving loading state.
- [AsyncButton](components/async-button/): Morphs into progress, then into success with a next step or an error with retry.
- [ButtonGroup](components/button-group/): Attached or spaced set of related buttons.
- [IconButton](components/icon-button/): Icon-only button whose label is required and becomes its accessible name.
- [CopyButton](components/copy-button/): Copies text, confirms in place and announces the result.
- [SegmentedControl](components/segmented-control/): A few mutually exclusive options with a travelling selection surface.
- [TextField](components/text-field/): Labelled input with a reserved message line and announced errors.
- [TextArea](components/text-area/): Multi-line input that grows with content and can count characters.
- [Select](components/select/): Single-select listbox with typeahead and keyboard support while open or closed.
- [Checkbox](components/checkbox/): Native checkbox, styled, with an indeterminate state.
- [RadioGroup](components/radio-group/): Native radios in a fieldset, vertical or horizontal.
- [Switch](components/switch/): Immediate on/off setting with a springing thumb.
- [Slider](components/slider/): Track press springs the thumb; drags follow the pointer and settle with momentum.
- [Tabs](components/tabs/): Roving-focus tabs with one shared indicator and unmounted inactive panels.
- [Menu](components/menu/): Action menu with arrows, typeahead, edge flipping and focus return.
- [CommandPalette](components/command-palette/): ⌘K search-and-jump dialog with fuzzy ranking. Powers this site's search.
- [Breadcrumbs](components/breadcrumbs/): Trail to the current page, marked with aria-current.
- [Pagination](components/pagination/): Page list that always keeps first, last and neighbours in view.
- [Dialog](components/dialog/): Modal with focus trap, inert page, single scroll lock and focus return.
- [AlertDialog](components/alert-dialog/): Confirmation that needs an explicit choice.
- [Sheet](components/sheet/): Edge panel; the bottom variant drags to dismiss from its handle only.
- [Popover](components/popover/): Anchored non-modal panel that flips, shifts and docks on narrow screens.
- [Tooltip](components/tooltip/): Short description on hover or keyboard focus, never on touch.
- [Toast](components/toast/): Transient notifications that pause on hover, focus and hidden tabs.
- [Accordion](components/accordion/): Measured height animation; collapsed content is unmounted.
- [Card](components/card/): Container-query-aware surface.
- [Stack](components/stack/): Flex layout on the space scale.
- [Divider](components/divider/): Separator, optionally labelled.
- [Badge](components/badge/): Compact status label; tone never carries meaning alone.
- [Avatar](components/avatar/): Photo or initials on a stable tint, plus groups with overflow.
- [Table](components/table/): Sortable semantic table with sticky header and empty state.
- [AnimatedNumber](components/animated-number/): Locale-formatted number that tweens; screen readers hear the settled value.
- [Kbd](components/kbd/): Keyboard key.
- [Alert](components/alert/): Inline status message whose exit removes it from the tab order.
- [Progress](components/progress/): Determinate or honest indeterminate progress.
- [Spinner](components/spinner/): Indeterminate activity with an accessible label.
- [Skeleton](components/skeleton/): Geometry-reserving placeholder; static under reduced motion.
- [EmptyState](components/empty-state/): Designed nothing-here-yet state with a next step.
- [OrloImage](components/image/): Image lifecycle with bounded retry, designed failure and a no-image mode.
- [ToggleButton](components/toggle-button/): A button that stays on, for formatting and view options.
- [ToggleGroup](components/toggle-group/): Toolbar of toggles with one tab stop and arrow-key movement.
- [SplitButton](components/split-button/): Primary action with a menu of related alternatives.
- [Fab](components/fab/): Floating action; extended label collapses while scrolling down.
- [SpeedDial](components/speed-dial/): A floating action that fans out a few labelled actions.
- [PasswordField](components/password-field/): Reveal that keeps the caret, Caps Lock warning and strength feedback.
- [NumberField](components/number-field/): Locale-aware spinbutton with clamping and hold-to-repeat steppers.
- [SearchField](components/search-field/): Debounced, IME-safe search with clear and busy states.
- [Combobox](components/combobox/): Editable autocomplete with local or remote filtering.
- [TagInput](components/tag-input/): Tokens from text; paste splits, duplicates explain themselves.
- [PinInput](components/pin-input/): One-time code boxes with paste-to-fill and autofill.
- [RadioCards](components/radio-cards/): Large, explanatory choices backed by native radios.
- [RangeSlider](components/range-slider/): Two thumbs that cannot cross; track press moves the nearest.
- [Rating](components/rating/): Star rating radiogroup with exact fractional read-only display.
- [Calendar](components/calendar/): Locale-aware month grid with full keyboard and range mode.
- [DatePicker](components/date-picker/): Field that opens a calendar popover and returns focus.
- [TimeField](components/time-field/): Segmented time entry in the locale’s 12- or 24-hour form.
- [ColorPicker](components/color-picker/): Area, hue, hex, swatches, eyedropper and a live contrast readout.
- [FileDropzone](components/file-dropzone/): Shows accept/reject before release and explains every rejection.
- [NavigationRail](components/navigation-rail/): Vertical rail of top-level destinations with a travelling pill.
- [BottomNavigation](components/bottom-navigation/): Phone navigation bar that respects the safe area.
- [Steps](components/steps/): Progress through a known sequence, never colour alone.
- [TableOfContents](components/table-of-contents/): On-this-page links with scrollspy; works without JavaScript.
- [ContextMenu](components/context-menu/): Right-click, Shift+F10 or long-press; kept on screen.
- [HoverCard](components/hover-card/): Rich preview after hover intent or keyboard focus.
- [Tour](components/tour/): Skippable spotlight walkthrough that skips missing targets.
- [TreeView](components/tree-view/): Hierarchy with the full WAI-ARIA tree keyboard model.
- [ReadMore](components/read-more/): Whole-line truncation with a toggle only when needed.
- [Splitter](components/splitter/): Resizable panes with a keyboard-operable separator.
- [ScrollArea](components/scroll-area/): Scroll region with edge shadows and keyboard focus.
- [Chip](components/chip/): Filter, assist and removable input chips.
- [DataList](components/data-list/): Key–value pairs as a description list that adapts to its container.
- [Timeline](components/timeline/): Chronological events with machine-readable times.
- [Sparkline](components/sparkline/): Inline trend that breaks at gaps and carries a data table.
- [Meter](components/meter/): Value in a range with semantic zones, as bar or gauge.
- [Highlight](components/highlight/): Accent-insensitive match highlighting.
- [RelativeTime](components/relative-time/): “3 minutes ago” that stays current, with the exact time on hand.
- [Banner](components/banner/): Page-level message that pushes content instead of covering it.
- [OfflineIndicator](components/offline-indicator/): Calm offline banner and a brief back-online confirmation.
- [ProgressRing](components/progress-ring/): Compact circular progress, determinate or indeterminate.
- [Carousel](components/carousel/): Native scroll-snap slides; autoplay off by default and pausable.
- [BeforeAfter](components/before-after/): Drag or arrow-key comparison of two images.
- [Lightbox](components/lightbox/): Gallery that opens full-screen with swipe and keyboard.
- [Icon](components/icon/): Around 270 original icons in three weights.
- [AnimatedIcon](components/animated-icon/): Icons whose motion carries meaning: draw, morph, ring, burst.
- [Knob](components/knob/): Rotary slider for studio-style tools; drag, arrows, double-click reset.
- [HoldToConfirm](components/hold-to-confirm/): Press and hold to confirm irreversible actions; release cancels.
- [SignaturePad](components/signature-pad/): Pressure-aware drawing with undo and a typed alternative.
- [ShortcutRecorder](components/shortcut-recorder/): Records key combos and warns about browser-reserved ones.
- [ReorderableList](components/reorderable-list/): Drag or keyboard reordering with spoken positions.
- [Heatmap](components/heatmap/): Calendar activity grid with keyboard exploration.
- [JsonTree](components/json-tree/): Collapsible JSON explorer with labelled types.
- [DiffViewer](components/diff-viewer/): Line diff with +/− gutters and a spoken summary.
- [CodeBlock](components/code-block/): Code with copy, line numbers, highlights and wrap.
- [Countdown](components/countdown/): Live timer that announces only meaningful moments.
- [Marquee](components/marquee/): Ambient scroller that pauses on hover, focus and reduced motion.
- [Text](components/text/): Type scale, tones, whole-line truncation and tabular numbers.
- [Heading](components/heading/): Semantic level and visual size chosen independently.
- [Prose](components/prose/): Long-form content with measure, rhythm and multilingual line breaking.
- [Truncate](components/truncate/): Middle truncation that keeps the start and end of names.
- [AsyncContent](components/async-content/): Loading, empty, error, offline and stale states for remote data.
- [VideoPlayer](components/video-player/): Orlo controls, shortcuts, buffering and error states; never autoplays sound.
- [AudioPlayer](components/audio-player/): Compact audio with seek, rate and failure handling.
- [Embed](components/embed/): Consent-gated, sandboxed third-party content with slow-load fallback.
- [MapView](components/map-view/): Location without surprise requests; interactive map after consent.
- [DocumentViewer](components/document-viewer/): Inline document preview with toolbar and download fallback.
- [DataGrid](components/data-grid/): Virtualised grid with sorting, selection, resizing and grid keyboard.
- [LineChart](components/line-chart/): Lines and areas with gaps, markers, keyboard crosshair and data table.
- [BarChart](components/bar-chart/): Grouped or stacked bars with a true zero baseline.
- [DonutChart](components/donut-chart/): Part-to-whole with focusable segments and spelled-out percentages.
- [Markdown](components/markdown/): Safe Markdown rendering to React elements, never raw HTML.
- [MarkdownEditor](components/markdown-editor/): Toolbar, shortcuts, preview and word count over native text.
- [ChatThread](components/chat-thread/): Conversation log that respects the reader's scroll position.
- [Composer](components/composer/): Message input: Enter sends, IME-safe, becomes Stop while generating.
- [ToolRun](components/tool-run/): Honest step-by-step status for tools, agents and pipelines.
- [ResponseFeedback](components/response-feedback/): Reversible helpful / not helpful signal.
- [AppShell](components/app-shell/): Header, resizable sidebar, main, inspector and status bar.
- [TabStrip](components/tab-strip/): Editor tabs with close, unsaved marks and keyboard reorder.
- [StatusBar](components/status-bar/): App footer for counts, modes and transient messages.
- [Kanban](components/kanban/): Board with pointer drag and a complete keyboard path.
- [ProgressiveBlur](components/progressive-blur/): Layered blur band so content softens under sticky chrome instead of being sliced.
- [StatCard](components/stat-card/): KPI with direction in icon, sign and words.
